title: GvR's Mobestiary
body:
Crafted with a book and spyglass, the Mobestiary can identify all mobs (currently 18 mobs and the player, but I'm working on it)! Simply right-click while aiming at a mob, and the book will tell you about it!
The Mobestiary contains text that is based on Minecraft's (not very apparent) lore, whilst having usefull info for any noobs out there.

For clarity, this is not the actual Mobestiary. It is merely based on it.

This is a datapack that uses the ability to create custom menus, which was added in 25w20a.
This datapack was made from an example datapack made by Conure as a base.

Please leave credit if you plan on using this for your own data pack, mod pack, video, etc. :)

Have not updated in a while, but will eventually.
